determinacy.why: Inverse functionality leaves Meta at most one subsidiary, so Instagram and WhatsApp cannot both remain; Meta may keep either, or neither if its one subsidiary is some other company.

assumes: Instagram is a subsidiary of Meta.
worlds.summary: Meta keeps Instagram; WhatsApp is no longer its subsidiary.

assumes: WhatsApp is a subsidiary of Meta.
worlds.summary: Meta keeps WhatsApp; Instagram is no longer its subsidiary.

assumes: Meta has subsidiaries other than Instagram and WhatsApp.
worlds.summary: Meta's one subsidiary is another company, so it loses both.

edit.statement: 'Is a subsidiary of' is inverse functional: each parent company has at most one subsidiary.
edit.subject: subsidiary_of
edit.original: A parent company can have many subsidiaries.
edit.scope: How many subsidiaries a single parent company can have.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is a subsidiary of' inverse functional, so that each parent company has at most one subsidiary?

cross_lingual.prompt: “是……的子公司”这一关系是否是反函数性的，即每家母公司最多只有一家子公司？
¿Es inversamente funcional la relación «es filial de», de modo que cada empresa matriz tiene como máximo una filial?

derived.prompt: Meta acquired both Instagram and WhatsApp. Is Instagram a subsidiary of Meta?
Meta acquired both Instagram and WhatsApp. Is WhatsApp a subsidiary of Meta?

unrelated_near.prompt: Is the relation 'has ISIN' inverse functional, so that no two securities share one ISIN?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is an ancestor of' transitive?

notes: Cross-lingual queries ask the property itself rather than an instance, since every instance is in doubt. The prompts state the acquisitions, which the edit leaves alone; whether an acquired company is still a subsidiary is what the worlds disagree on.
